sample_unit: questions (25 AF and 25 CIED questions entered into each of three chatbots)

links.outcome: Appropriateness and completeness of chatbot answers on AF and CIED questions
links.effect: Fully appropriate responses: AF 52% (Bard), 60% (Bing), 84% (ChatGPT Plus); CIEDs 16%, 72%, 88%. Relevant aspects missing: AF 52%, 60%, 24%; CIEDs 92%, 88%, 52%.
links.quote: Relevant aspects were missing in 52% (GB), 60% (BC), and 24% (CGP) for AF, and in 92% (GB), 88% (BC), and 52% (CGP) for CIEDs.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates off-the-shelf LLM chatbots (Google Bard, Bing Chat, ChatGPT Plus) for answering patient questions regarding atrial fibrillation and cardiac devices without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
